EURUSD.state: The engine is separating immediate downside pressure from broader regime quality. The bearish leg is real, but the broader state remains transition/chop rather than a clean directional regime.
paragraphs:
ENGINE READ
The immediate chart has a 6-brick downside extension, but the broader engine has not converted that move into a clean directional regime. Balance/range remains the dominant family at 94.5, while bearish reversal/transition is 75.3 and compression 65.8. Bearish expansion/escape is present at 49.4, but the older bullish continuation families have not disappeared completely: stair-step continuation is 33.7 and clean continuation 19.1. That hierarchy is the important point: the engine is reading a transfer of control and unstable reorganization, not a mature one-sided trend. The public regime values also barely changed on the latest update — continuation 34.3 → 33.7, transition pressure 75.2 → 75.3, and balance/chop 94.0 → 94.5 — so the latest downside bricks extended price more than they changed the broader regime classification.

STRUCTURE & PRESSURE
The confirmed swing map is lower-high/lower-low and expanding downward. Price has already moved beneath the latest confirmed low at 1.14550, while the latest confirmed high remains 1.16400. The recent run sequence (+2, -2, +1, -2, +1, -4, +1, -6, +1, -1, +2, -6) shows why the engine still refuses to call the environment orderly: directional bursts keep appearing inside frequent changes of control. LR150-S8 is falling at 1.16086 with price below it, and SAR sits overhead at 1.14808. At the same time, opposing wick pressure is low and stable; the recent opposing-wick/body measure fell from 0.7726 to 0.6019. So the current downward leg has structural and dynamic pressure behind it, but it is developing inside an irregular regime rather than a cleanly synchronized trend.

PATTERN & VOLATILITY
Bollinger width is expanded but contracting; the middle band is 1.14295 and the lower band 1.13458. That means volatility is still broad, but the envelope is beginning to narrow while price trades in its lower half. Against that bearish swing structure, the engine is simultaneously carrying a live bull Developing Bat with X 1.13531, A 1.17115, B 1.15662, C 1.16541, and D 1.13900. The nearest older confirmed low below current price is 1.13850; together with Bat X at 1.13531 and the lower Bollinger band at 1.13458, that creates a tightly grouped lower-price reference area. The key conflict is therefore not 'bullish versus bearish' in isolation: the Bat is a live counter-structure feature forming while the confirmed swing map and current run still point down. The engine has not promoted that counter-structure into a reversal.

WHAT CHANGES THE READ
Part 3 remains unresolved because no single regime has separated far enough from the competing structures. The current reading stays transitional while alternation, irregular timing and competing structures remain present. Unstable transition: Control repeatedly shifts without a stable replacement regime. It weakens when one side gains coherent run/pace control. It is replaced when directional regime or stable range replaces instability. Disorderly chop / unstable balance: High alternation and irregular timing prevent coherent directional control. It weakens when one side develops consistent runs and timing. It is replaced when directional state or orderly range replaces disorder. In practical engine terms, the read changes only when one side develops sustained run-and-timing control or when an orderly range replaces the current unstable balance; another isolated directional burst by itself is not enough.
